name: poly_triple_reflex_divergence
description: Which diagonals a triangulation cuts on a ring with a REFLEX corner. Measured by task 1140, CLOSED by task 1190. The vertex sets match completely in both cells -- no vertex is created or moved by either engine -- so the whole subject is which vertices make a triangle, which is why this case carries the face channel at all: a vertex-only check calls it parity either way. As measured, our fan started at ring vertex 0 and on the pentagon (0,0,0) (4,0,0) (4,0,4) (2,0,1) (0,0,4) emitted (0,0,0)-(4,0,0)-(4,0,4), a triangle CONTAINING the reflex corner (2,0,1), so the output overlapped itself; the hexagon did the same with (0,0,0)-(3,0,0)-(3,0,3). Task 1190 replaced the fan with largest-area ear clipping and the two engines now agree on every triangle -- ring rotation AND winding included. The DECLARED GAP IS THEREFORE EMPTY, in both the vertex and the face channel, and the runner recomputes it live: any drift on either side reddens this suite.
source: Reference side: headless command-port capture of the triangulate command (dirty-geometry sweep, task 1123, cases tri_reflex_mid / tri_reflex_hex), UNTOUCHED since task 1140. vibe3d side: re-read live off this build by task 1190 after the ear-clipping port.

provenance.notes: INSTRUMENT: the reference side is a BEHAVIOURAL CAPTURE driven through the reference editor's own headless command port -- no display, no pointer, no debugger and no static read of its binary; every number in `reference` is a coordinate the reference itself printed after running the operation on the mesh in `input`. The vibe3d side is a LIVE DRIVE of this build over the HTTP test API through the very steps this fixture stores, read back from /api/model. Both engines are given the SAME base mesh (the reference's own dump, injected verbatim) and the selection travels by COORDINATE, so no element index is assumed to mean the same thing on both sides. Nothing here is an inference about the reference's internals; where a MECHANISM is guessed at, the case note says so in that word. REGENERATED 2026-08-18 (task 1190): only the vibe3d side and the derived gap were re-read; the reference block is byte-identical to the 1140 capture.

cases.name: reflex_pentagon
cases.note: 5 vertices, 7 edges, 3 triangles on both sides, and since task 1190 the same three: {(4,0,0)(4,0,4)(2,0,1)}, {(2,0,1)(0,0,4)(0,0,0)}, {(0,0,0)(4,0,0)(2,0,1)} -- the fan from the reflex corner, every triangle inside the ring. The old fan's (0,0,0)-(4,0,0)-(4,0,4), which contained (2,0,1), is gone.

cases.name: reflex_hexagon
cases.note: 6 vertices, 9 edges, 4 triangles on both sides, and since task 1190 the same four. Note this cell is NOT a fan from the reflex corner: the reference cuts E-A before D-F, which is what pins the ear rule to LARGEST AREA (2.25 against 1.5) rather than to the reflex corner or to the shortest diagonal -- the fan from (2,0,1) is the shorter total by 6.478 against 7.004 and is not what either engine emits.
